class.name: ResourceLocalizationServer
class.brief_description: Loads localized resources (voice, textures, fonts) through [method @GDScript.load] from [ResourceLocalizationCatalog]s.

method.name: get_localized_path
method.description: Returns the localized path of the resource [param path] for [param locale], or [param path] itself if no catalog has a path for it. An empty [param locale] means the active locale: then it is one hash lookup in the resolved data, the same that [method @GDScript.load] uses. The existence of the file is not checked.

method.name: get_localized_paths
method.description: Returns all localized paths of the resource [param path] as a [Dictionary] of locale to path, over all layers (a higher layer overrides the path of a locale). Empty if no catalog lists [param path]. Reads all locales of the catalogs; meant for tools and checks.

method.name: get_missing_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of [method LocalizationServer.get_available_locales] that have no localized path for the resource [param path], for example to list missing voice files of a language.

method.name: has_localization
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a catalog lists the resource [param path]. Such paths are loaded through this server and are not remapped by [code]translation_remaps[/code] anymore.

method.name: is_relocalizing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while cached resources are loaded again after a locale or catalog change, until [signal resources_relocalized] is emitted.

signal.name: resources_relocalized
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when the cached resources of [param paths] (their original paths) were loaded again for a new locale or catalog and updated in place. Changes during a running relocalization are queued and reported by the next emission.
